The area AA of a regular polygon with nn sides of length xx is A=nx2cos(π/n)4sin(π/n)A=\frac{nx^2\cos(\pi/n)}{4\sin(\pi/n)}.

  1. Simplify the formula when n=6n=6 to obtain the area of a regular hexagon. (2 marks)

  2. Use increments to estimate the change in area of a regular hexagon when its side length increases from 10 cm to 10.5 cm. (3 marks)

  3. Use increments to estimate the change in area of a regular polygon with side length 10 cm when its number of sides increases from 29 to 31. (3 marks)

subject: Mathematics Methods
subtopics: Probability distributions, expectation and binomial models
html:
1. 17% of a large number of smoke alarms in a building complex are faulty. An electrician randomly selects 8 alarms. Determine (i) the probability none is faulty (2 marks); (ii) the probability more than three are faulty, given that at least one is faulty (2 marks); (iii) the standard deviation of the number faulty (1 mark).

  2. In a newer complex only 7% of alarms are faulty. Determine, with reasoning, the minimum number to inspect so that the probability at least one is faulty exceeds 99%. (3 marks)
